title: Optional hourly coordinator refresh owned by the main base
goal: An opt-in hourly job that dispatches the coordinator refresh from the main base (NERV-01 until F-016 is done) and skips when a run is already queued or running
acceptance: Off by default; the owner turns it on in settings; it runs only on the base that holds the coordinator role and only when the pilot's stage and grant admit an unattended write-external call, otherwise it records why it skipped
Skips when github.runs.status shows a queued or in-progress run; a failed dispatch is retried at the next hour, never in a loop
Tests with a fake clock and the fake GitHub API: one dispatch per hour, none on a non-main base, none while a run is in progress, none when not admitted
privacy: Neutral invented repositories, workflows and runs in tests; the GitHub token never in git, config.json, tests, logs, chat or the relocation snapshot.
escalation: A schedule more often than hourly goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one scheduled job on the existing scheduler with main-base and admission checks. Not a measurement.
